raw.query: SELECT run_id, gpu_hours, achieved_p99_ms, is_violation, v_pool_cost.is_current FROM provenance.v_pool_cost JOIN provenance.v_infraction USING (run_id) WHERE run_id IN ('planner:week_fc_p50', 'planner:week_fc_p90') AND sla_metric='ttft';
raw.observed: planner:week_fc_p50 (gpu_hours=319.91, TTFT p99=827.81ms, is_violation=false), planner:week_fc_p90 (gpu_hours=518.61, TTFT p99=651.14ms); savings = (518.61 - 319.91) / 518.61 = 38.31%
raw.claimed: the p50 forecast also passes the week on the language pool (TTFT p99 828 ms, 319.9 GPU-hours: 38% cheaper than p90)
raw.evidence: v_pool_cost and v_infraction confirm planner:week_fc_p50 achieves 319.91 H100 GPU-hours and TTFT p99 of 827.81 ms with no violation, representing a 38.31% savings over planner:week_fc_p90 (518.61 H100 GPU-hours). Prior verifier deepseek-v4-pro incorrectly queried the factorial-based v_closedloop_frontier under 'steady24h' rather than the week-scale 'planner' replay runs.
